answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own wander record, and its own share of the pearl quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The zephyr ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 4 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 1147 identities would post 1311 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
